thread:
Maya R.: quick heads-up  invoice-preview flagged some tenants with negative prorated credits for the 02:00 hour. looks like a double-count, not a refund bug
Jonas V.: negative credits? that's wild. do you have an example tenant id?
Maya R.: tenant t-987 showed -42 credits on preview. digging into the raw events, same request_id appears twice but with different shard_ack timestamps
Priya S.: shard_ack duplication usually means retries + non-idempotent write. any recent fanout or retry config changes?
Maya R.: we had a fanout batching tweak last week to increase parallelism (parallel_batches=8 -> 12). thought it was safe but maybe it exposed a race in our dedupe window
MeteringBot: alert: dedupe-window-overlap detected (30% increase in cross-shard duplicates) 514 see https://console/redwood/metering/alerts/8891
Jonas V.: can you paste the event example (sanitized)?
Maya R.: ```{
  "request_id": "r-5a2f",
  "tenant": "t-987",
  "route": "embed-heavy",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T02:00:12Z",
  "shard_id": "s-42",
  "shard_ack": "2026-03-20T02:01:05Z"
}
-- duplicate: same request_id, shard_id s-17, shard_ack 2026-03-20T02:01:07Z```
Priya S.: aha. two different shards wrote the same request_id because our fingerprint extraction is happening post-fanout in the writer, not at the router. move it earlier and it should prevent duplicates
Asha M.: pushing fingerprint upstream is non-trivial for the router codepath. alternative quick fix: expand dedupe-window to include cross-shard acknowledgements for 3s, and add a best-effort idempotency token on the write path
Carlos D.: expanding dedupe-window helps but will increase memory in the jewelry cache. what's the expected delta?
Maya R.: estimate +8% memory for kv-cache; previews show this prevents the negative credits for 95% of sampled tenants
Jonas V.: we should do a preview-only patch first. proposal: 1) feature flag `dedupe_cross_shard_window_secs=3` for previews, 2) emit `fingerprint_pre_router` in traces, 3) run preview diffs and perf smoke for cache memory
Priya S.: +1. i'll own the router change to compute fingerprint pre-fanout. i can do a minimal patch that doesn't change wire format: just compute in-router and put in ctx
MeteringBot: task created: METER-1345 Add pre-router fingerprint + preview dedupe flag 4dd assigned to Priya S. eta 2026-03-22
Asha M.: dashboard request: add "cross-shard dup rate" and a small heatmap by shard pair. also add a card in invoice-preview showing "dup preventions applied" count so product sees impact
Carlos D.: don't forget to alert SRE if dedupe-window is toggled; we could see cache pressure spikes. Asha, can you add a runbook note?
Asha M.: on it. runbook note: if kv-cache pressure > 85% or eviction rate > 5/s, rollback flag and notify #eng-infra
Maya R.: operational plan: Priya ships router fingerprint canary -> enable preview flag for 3 tenants -> run invoice diffs and cache smoke -> if good, rollout preview-wide and schedule a planned migration to move fingerprint upstream in the next sprint
Jonas V.: also add a small consumer-side metric: `writes_with_pre_router_fp` so we can verify adoption before flipping live
Priya S.: starting the canary PR now, marking WIP. will add unit + integration test for duplicate suppression
Maya R.: thanks. i'll post preview diff once canary completes. if anyone sees tenant t-987 in production alerts, ping me directly
MeteringBot: deploybot: preview-flag toggled for sample tenants t-987,t-654 by Jonas V.
Maya R.: (after) preview diff: t-987 delta from -42 -> +1 (fixed), t-654 delta -3 -> 0. memory impact within expected bounds. proceeding to schedule rollout to all previews. :white_check_mark:
